description: 전북특별자치도_천연가스버스 현황 [bus and public transit and gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 전북특별자치도. 이 데이터는 전북특별자치도 내 천연가스(CNG) 버스 운행 현황을 연도별로 정리한 통계자료입니다. 2016년부터 2019년까지의 기간 동안 시내버스, 시외버스, 마을버스 등에서 운행. The portal shows 2025-08-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
